description: Mediation Boards Commission - Notice calling for Nominations for the Appointment of Mediators
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the appointment of mediators for Special Mediation Boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves the Mediation Boards Commission (a judicial/legal body) calling for nominations and outlining the appointment process for mediators who will resolve land disputes. The content focuses on judicial appointments and procedures rather than government personnel changes, land transactions themselves, or other specialized categories.
